title: Distribute Candies
description:
Alice has n candies, where each candy belongs to a type given in the array candyType[i].

Recently, she realized she’s gaining weight, so she consulted a doctor. The doctor advised her to eat only n / 2 candies (note: n is always even).

Alice still wants to enjoy her candies as much as possible, so her goal is to eat the maximum number of different candy types while following the doctor’s restriction.

Given the array candyType, return the maximum number of distinct types of candies she can eat if she eats only n / 2 candies.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
constraints:
n == candyType.length
2 <= n <= 10^4
n is even
-10^5 <= candyType[i] <= 10^5
